depiction.primary_object: two human head-and-shoulder silhouettes side by side
modifiers: two curved sound or signal waves radiating from the left figure toward the right figure
depiction.composition: two identical figures horizontally aligned with directional wave arcs between them

readings.meaning: speaking to someone, talking, or having a one-on-one conversation
telling, informing, or briefing another person in person
peer-to-peer wireless sharing (e.g. AirDrop) or proximity transmission

ambiguity: Could be read as coughing/contagion distance in a medical context, or wireless data transfer between two users, though 'talking to someone' is the natural default.

modifier_semantics.modifier: two curved sound waves between the figures
modifier_semantics.meaning: speech, voice, or signal transmitted from one person to another

task_intents: tell or inform a specific person
ask a neighbor or colleague directly
practice conversational speaking with a partner
conduct an interview or coaching session
give verbal feedback to a report
discuss a sensitive matter face to face

example_tasks.task: Speak with Mr. Alvarez after pickup about Leo's reading group
Catch Marcus at his desk to explain the staging rollback
Give Lena honest feedback on the client deck before Thursday
Ask the pharmacist at Walgreens about taking magnesium with dinner
Have the roommates sit-down about splitting the winter gas bill
Pull Dave aside after rehearsal to sort out the bridge tempo
Sit down with Sam tonight to go over how much screen time fits school nights
Walk through the bathroom tile quote face to face with Victor before he orders materials

Text Omi the flight number once we board
Buy a Bluetooth speaker for the patio

reasoning: Shows two person silhouettes with sound waves traveling from one to the other, clearly conveying speaking to someone face-to-face or a one-on-one conversation. To-do lists are full of 'talk to X', 'tell Y', and '1:1 with Z' items where the act of talking in person (as opposed to calling or texting) is the core task.
